messages:
elaine: Quick follow-up from the RFC review — proposing we split model ingress validation into two distinct phases: 'slice microbench' for perf/regression and 'golden quality' for correctness checks. thoughts?
raj: +1 on split. microbench lets infra iterate fast without waiting for heavy evals.
tom: Agree. Can we make microbench deterministic-ish? we need stable seq len and prompt templates to compare p50/p95.
sasha: We should also lock the runtime ABI for the microbench run. Any shim removals must be coorded with runtime team.
elaine: Good point. Proposal: microbench runs on a stable shimbed binary for speed, but we add a compatibility assertion step to catch missing KV-cache hooks before golden quality.
raj: Compatibility assertion = small smoke that verifies: model loads, kv cache read/write, kv eviction policy works, and a single-step token match for a golden prompt. cheap and fast.
tom: Example command I had in mind:
```bash
./bench_runner --model $MODEL --mode micro --profile seq=128,samples=200 
./compat_check --model $MODEL --probe kv-read-write --golden-cmd 'echo "hello" | run'
```
low cost, runs in <5min per model on a dev GPU.
sasha: Where do we store the compatibility artifact? We need an immutable record for rollbacks.
elaine: store in model-registry as metadata blob (sha + diff summary). The golden quality stage will refuse promotion if the compat artifact is missing or shows drift.
raj: For golden quality, suggest we run 200-quality inputs with eval harness (LLM-eval), plus a small human spot-check for hallucination-sensitive models.
tom: Also add an automated quantization sanity step — quick FP16->int8 parity check for logits top-3 on a 50-sample set. catches catastrophic quantization failures early.
sasha: Operationally, we need a circuit-breaker: if microbench p95 exceeds threshold OR compat check fails, auto-stop pipeline and tag model as 'needs-engineer'.
elaine: Agreed. Action items: (1) raj to draft compat assertion spec (2) tom to standardize microbench template + tool config (3) sasha to add storage hook to registry and circuit-breaker. I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow. :calendar: 
raj: I'll drop a short example JSON schema for the compat artifact in #eng-ml after lunch.
tom: I'll prototype the microbench template and add it to the repo under tools/bench-templates.
sasha: I'll spike the registry hook — probably add an endpoint /models/:id/compat-artifact. bench-bot: Scheduled microbench for candidate model "m-weird-42" at 2026-03-15T13:02:00Z. Results will be posted to the thread. :robot_face:
